name: Question 1
problem:
Given that the discrete random variable $Y$ has the probability mass function $f(y)$ and the cumulative distribution function $F(y)$ as shown in the table below, compute $a+b+c.$

| $y$ | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $f(y)$ | $0.1$ | $0.2$ | $0.2$ | $0.4$ | $0.1$ |
| $F(y)$ | $0.1$ | $a$ | $0.5$ | $b$ | $c$ |
worked_solution:
The cumulative distribution function of a discrete random variable $Y$ is a function $F(y)$ such that

$$
F(y)=P(Y\le y).
$$

Computing $a,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}a & =F(1) \\  & =P(Y\le 1) \\  & =P(Y\in {0,1}) \\  & =f(0)+f(1) \\  & =0.1+0.2 \\  & =0.3.\end{aligned}
$$

Computing $b,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}b & =F(3) \\  & =P(Y\le 3) \\  & =P(Y\in {0,1,2,3}) \\  & =f(0)+f(1)+f(2)+f(3) \\  & =0.1+0.2+0.2+0.4 \\  & =0.9.\end{aligned}
$$

Computing $c,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}c & =F(4) \\  & =P(Y\le 4) \\  & =P(Y\in {0,1,2,3,4}) \\  & =f(0)+f(1)+f(2)+f(3)+f(4) \\  & =0.1+0.2+0.2+0.4+0.1 \\  & =1.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
a+b+c=0.3+0.9+1=2.2.
$$

Question 1
?

Given that the discrete random variable Y has the probability mass function f(y) and the cumulative distribution function F(y) as shown in the table below, compute a+b+c.

y 0 1 2 3 4
f(y) 0.1 0.2 0.2 0.4 0.1
F(y) 0.1 a 0.5 b c
a
 1.0
b
 1.8
c
 2.2
d
 0.7
e
 1.5
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

The cumulative distribution function of a discrete random variable Y is a function F(y) such that

F(y)=P(Y≤y).

Computing a, we get a=F(1)=P(Y≤1)=P(Y∈{0,1})=f(0)+f(1)=0.1+0.2=0.3.

Computing b, we get b=F(3)=P(Y≤3)=P(Y∈{0,1,2,3})=f(0)+f(1)+f(2)+f(3)=0.1+0.2+0.2+0.4=0.9.

Computing c, we get c=F(4)=P(Y≤4)=P(Y∈{0,1,2,3,4})=f(0)+f(1)+f(2)+f(3)+f(4)=0.1+0.2+0.2+0.4+0.1=1.

Therefore,

a+b+c=0.3+0.9+1=2.2.
